Same-host PowerShell 4104 shows `sc.exe stop CsgTelemetryForwarder`, `sc.exe config {target} start= auto`, and `sc.exe start CsgTelemetryForwarder` in that order. Forwarder stop/start records bracket the attempted change, and the matching 7040 is absent. The same script disables Defender, stages documents, and attempts an outbound transfer.
